description: This file defines a class 'CustomField' within the OpenCart platform, specifically in the catalog controller for account-related custom fields. It handles retrieving custom field data for a customer group and returning it as a JSON response.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Controller class for handling custom field retrieval, extending the base Opencart engine controller.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that determines customer group ID, loads the custom field model, and outputs the customer's custom fields as JSON.
